integrity: One unified mathematical theorem with a quantitative exact identity and its rigidity application; analytic proof applies at every disk radius. Independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact first circular moment is established for sense-preserving locally univalent harmonic maps on the disk only; no boundary energy finiteness, uniqueness of sharpness extremizers, or resolution of harmonic inner-radius conjectures is asserted. The Möbius classification also follows by a short combination of previously published bounds, so novelty is confined to the sharp circlewise hyperbolic-energy identity.
title: Sharp angular hyperbolic-energy law for harmonic order
